meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 装上后,驱动它的编码工具会把旧版 NanoClaw 和 Claude 的记忆文件迁入新的共享记忆目录。流程包括:先找出受影响的群组并暂停任务,把旧文件移入暂存区,再分类整理成统一格式,最后验证迁移并让操作者确认。
howto.when: 当系统更新后报告共享记忆不兼容,或检测到旧版记忆文件(如 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md、Claude 自动记忆)时触发。也可以直接说“migrate memory”等指令唤起。

say.text: 我更新后代理忘了一切,请迁移我的旧版记忆。
say.note: 会触发技能开始扫描并迁移。
技能会先显示计划,获得批准后才移动。

howto.what_en: This skill makes the coding harness that runs it (e.g. Claude Code) migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree. It pauses affected groups, stages files, organizes them into the standard format, and verifies the result with operator approval.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, when legacy memory files (.seed.md, CLAUDE.md, Claude auto-memory) are detected, or on phrases like "migrate memory".

say_en.text: After the update my agent forgot everything—please migrate my old memory.
Merge the behavioral rules from CLAUDE.md into instructions.prepend.md.
say_en.note: The file is staged and classified for merging.
Shows a plan and waits for approval before moving.
